title: Clinical state annotation (Level 0 — no surface, no span)
description: Per-annotation record for clinical state representation. Designed to be ontology-linkable and re-identification-safe.

ord.description: Stable ordinal within a case (NOT a span position)

hpo_id.description: HPO identifier (e.g., HP:0001945) or '-' if not assigned

category.description: Clinical section / category. Free-text vocabulary controlled by project convention.

tier.description: Quality tier. v0.1.0 = machine self-evaluation only.

iteration.description: RLM iteration at which this annotation was added (0 = initial extract)

reviewer_role.description: Reviewer role for privacy; null in v0.1.0

ontology_links.description: Optional links to other ontologies (Mondo, SNOMED, etc.). Not required for HPO-only profile.

is_synthetic.description: Must be true for any example committed to this public repository
